desc.en: Every piece is a set of vectors. Place one anywhere and watch its attack domain; then stand the minimum-move field up as a third axis and see that a knight's distance field is not flat — orthogonally adjacent squares are always 3 moves away, while diagonally adjacent ones are 2 in the middle and 4 in the corner. "Control the centre" stops being a slogan and becomes a number: a knight attacks 8 squares from d4 and 2 from a1.
desc.zh: 每个棋子就是一组向量。把它放到任意格上看它的攻击域；再把最少步数场立成第三根轴，就会看到马的距离场不是平的——正相邻恒为 3 步，而对角相邻在中心是 2 步、在角上是 4 步。「占中心」从此不是口号而是一个数字：马在 d4 攻击 8 格，在 a1 只有 2 格。

desc.en: A legal move is a pseudo-legal move that does not expose your own king. Both sets are drawn at once in two colours, and the difference between them is exactly what a pin is. Castling's four preconditions each get their own indicator, including the one everyone gets wrong: on the queenside the b-file square must be empty but need not be safe, because the king never passes over it. Checkmate is not a special state — it is the move list going empty while the king is attacked.
desc.zh: 合法走法就是不让自己的王暴露的伪合法走法。两个集合同屏双色画出，它们的差集正好就是「别子」。易位的四个前提各有一盏灯，包括那条几乎人人写错的：长易位时 b 列必须为空但不必安全，因为王根本不经过它。将死不是一种特殊状态——它就是合法走法列表空掉、而王正被攻击。

desc.en: A whole game is one curve in three dimensions. Stand the move number up as a third axis and every piece's life becomes a line: the knight that zig-zagged across nine moves and the bishop that never left its square are suddenly the same kind of object. Thirty games from 1750 to 2017 come with the story of why each one mattered, and the replay stops itself at the moves that decided them. Three curves — material, squares controlled, king safety — run alongside, and the tool tells you exactly how crude each of them is.
desc.zh: 一整局棋就是三维里的一条曲线。把回合数立成第三根轴，每颗子的一生都成了一条线：那只来回折了九步的马，和那只一步没离开原格的象，忽然成了同一类东西。三十局棋从 1750 年到 2017 年，每一局都带着「它为什么重要」的背景故事，回放走到决定胜负的那一步会自己停下来。旁边跑着三条曲线——子力差、控制格数、王的安全度——而工具会明确告诉你它们各自粗糙在哪。

desc.en: The real source of minimax and alpha-beta single-steps on the left while the game tree it is building grows on the right — the debugger's call stack is literally the path highlighted in the tree. Step onto the line `if (beta <= alpha) break;` and a whole limb collapses. Tree width is scaled by leaf count, so the volume alpha-beta removes is something you can see rather than a ratio you are told. At depth 4 plain minimax runs out of interpreter steps and returns nothing at all while alpha-beta finishes comfortably: not slower, unable. The last tab leaves the tree behind and puts the branching factor on a log axis, where doubling the depth you can reach still leaves you 46 plies short of one game.
desc.zh: 左边是 minimax 与 α-β 的真实源码在单步跑，右边是它正在建的那棵博弈树——调试器的调用栈就是树上高亮的那条路径。走到 `if (beta <= alpha) break;` 那一行，整片枝子当场塌掉。树的横向宽度按叶子数缩放，所以 α-β 省下的体积是看得见的一块，而不是别人告诉你的一个倍数。深度 4 上纯 minimax 耗尽解释器步数、什么也返回不了，α-β 却从容跑完：不是慢一点，是做不到。最后一个页签离开树，把分支因子放到对数轴上——把算得完的深度翻一倍，离一整局棋仍然差 46 个半步。

tag.en: minimax · alpha-beta · move ordering · Shannon number
tag.zh: 极小极大 · α-β 剪枝 · 走法排序 · 香农数

changelog.en: First release: tree / prune / order / shannon tabs. The algorithm source runs inside the step-by-step interpreter and the game tree is derived entirely from the call stack. Tree width scales with leaf count so pruned volume is visible; depth 4 is where plain minimax hits the interpreter's 200,000-step ceiling and is presented as the lesson rather than as a fault. Also: the evaluation broken into its two terms (read out of whatever source you have edited, never a hard-coded copy of the formula), a per-depth table of what move ordering saves, and Export .js for a file that runs under node.
changelog.zh: 首发：tree / prune / order / shannon 四个页签。算法源码在可单步的解释器里真的跑，博弈树完全从调用栈推导出来。树宽按叶子数缩放，剪掉的体积因此看得见；深度 4 上纯 minimax 撞上解释器的 200,000 步上限，这一格被当成课来讲而不是当成故障。另含评估函数的两项分解（从你此刻改过的源码里问出来，不是抄一份写死的公式）、按深度的排序省量小表，以及 Export .js——导出的文件直接能在 node 里跑。
